compatibility-required.reason: The three-OS by three-Python compatibility matrix is intentionally not repeated by the local aggregate.

node-required.reason: The Node 22 and Node 24 compatibility matrix remains a hosted runtime boundary; task ci validates the locked primary Node toolchain once.

posture.reason: The strict posture job reads GitHub ruleset, code-scanning, and Dependabot state through repository-scoped APIs.

hosted_required_contexts.codeql-required: GitHub-hosted CodeQL analysis and SARIF processing have no credential-free local equivalent.
hosted_required_contexts.dependency-review: GitHub Dependency Review requires pull-request dependency metadata from GitHub.
hosted_required_contexts.scorecard-required: OpenSSF Scorecard relies on hosted repository and workflow metadata.
